title: Pushes, Pulls and Motion
seo_title: Kindergarten Science: Pushes, Pulls and Motion Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: The motion of objects depends on their properties: the effects of pushes and pulls on movement (bounce, roll, slide), and the effects of size, shape and materials on movement. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science K, Physics)
meta_desc: Free Kindergarten science worksheets (BC): pushes and pulls, strong and gentle forces, rolling and sliding, and how shape changes motion. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: A push or a pull makes things move.
key_sub: Round things roll; flat things slide.
body_html:
How to think about it

Pushes and pulls make things move, stop or turn.

  • A push moves something away from you.
  • A pull moves something toward you.
  • A harder push makes it go faster.
Example

You open a drawer. Is that a push or a pull?

The drawer comes toward you.

Answer: a pull

Example

Which rolls best: a ball or a block?

Round things roll.

Answer: a ball

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a ball keeps rolling forever on grass.
  • Mixing up push and pull.
